title: Nutty Korean Chilli Jjigae
description: A show-off Korean dish featuring ancho chillies and ssam-wrap, with a twist of ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients. For a spicy and nutty twist on traditional Korean chilli jjigae.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add ancho chillies and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add 1 onion, diced, and cook for 3 minutes, until softened.
Add 2 cloves garlic, minced, and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
